changed_files.description: Paths this run is responsible for: files changed against base_ref whose content also differs from the pre-run snapshot. Acceptance is judged on this list.

full_changed_files.description: Every path differing from base_ref, including work the lane already carried before this run. Always a superset of changed_files.

unified_diff.description: Bounded diff against base_ref, so it covers full_changed_files -- not changed_files. The two are deliberately different slices: do not expect them to match 1:1.

passed.description: True or false when the verifier ran. Absent -- not null -- when it did not; read `outcome`.

source.description: Only bridge-verifier counts as evidence. agent-reported is the agent's own claim, whose exit code belongs to the last statement of a shell chain.

outcome.description: What happened to this run. `not_run` means the verifier never got to it; `passed` is absent then, rather than false.

not_run_reason.description: Why a not_run row did not run: cancelled, timeout.

tests_skipped_reason.description: Why `tests` is empty. null means the verifier ran and these are its results, so it is never the answer for a job that ended before the verifier: those report JOB_ENDED_EARLY, and `blocked_reason` names the specific cause.

mounted_paths.description: Paths copied into the lane for this job, named so a reviewer can tell them from the worker's own files

output_truncated.description: The agent's answer hit the output budget and was cut; the work on disk is still real

lane_released.description: The lane produced nothing and was removed with its branch

lane_retained_reason.description: Why the lane was kept: UNCOMMITTED_CHANGES, LANE_HAS_COMMITS, CLEANUP_DISABLED, ...

verifier_touched_files.description: Paths that appeared between the worker finishing and the verifier finishing, so an artifact the test suite wrote is not counted as delivered work.

ok.description: Whether this receipt reports success. Read this, or `status`, rather than the `ok` on the poll envelope, which reports delivery of the record and not the outcome of the job.

lane_commit.description: What the bridge did with the worker's uncommitted changes after the verifier ran. `committed: false` with a `reason` means the work is in the worktree only.

worker_written_files.description: Paths the worker itself wrote, before the verifier ran. Compare with `verifier_touched_files`: an expected artifact that appears only there was written by the test run, not delivered.

foreign_changed_files.description: Changed paths outside expected_artifacts; drives UNEXPECTED_CHANGED_FILES.

stop_reason.description: How the agent's turn ended, verbatim from ACP: end_turn, cancelled, max_turns. `cancelled` is not by itself a failure -- turn exhaustion and an output-budget stop both land here, and the verifier still ran.

agent_version.description: Grok CLI version that ran the job.
